cd /workspace
# q27

CREATE TABLE flag AS SELECT * FROM read_csv_auto('flagged.csv', header=true);
COPY (
 SELECT cod_imovel, split_part(cod_imovel,'-',2) AS entity_id,

"
echo "--- q27 ---"; head -5 answers/q27.csv; echo "..."
# q28/q29 reconciliation
time duckdb -box -c "
LOAD spatial; LOAD httpfs; SET geometry_always_xy=true;
CREATE TABLE flag AS SELECT * FROM read_csv_auto('flagged.csv', header=true);
CREATE TABLE pc AS SELECT cod_imovel, ST_Transform(ST_Centroid(geometry),'EPSG:4326','EPSG:31982') AS gm FROM read_parquet('parcels.parquet') WHERE cod_imovel IN (SELECT cod_imovel FROM flag);
CREATE TABLE fac AS SELECT tier, ST_Transform(geometry,'EPSG:4326','EPSG:31982') AS gm
  FROM read_parquet('https://data.source.coop/tristangruppwri/soft-commodity-infrastructure/facilities/BR_facilities.parquet')
  WHERE tier IN ('slaughter_point','intake_point','gravity_catchment');
CREATE TABLE fr AS SELECT f.cod_imovel, split_part(f.cod_imovel,'-',2) muni, CASE f.annex1_commodity WHEN 'cattle' THEN 'slaughter_point' WHEN 'soy' THEN 'intake_point' END rtier FROM flag f;
COPY (
 SELECT fr.cod_imovel,
   1 AS relationship_candidates,
   (SELECT count(*) FROM fac WHERE fac.tier=fr.rtier AND ST_Distance(fac.gm,pc.gm)<=50000) AS delivery_candidates,
   (SELECT count(*) FROM fac WHERE fac.tier='gravity_catchment' AND ST_Distance(fac.gm,pc.gm)<=50000) AS catchment_candidates,
   1 + (SELECT count(*) FROM fac WHERE fac.tier=fr.rtier AND ST_Distance(fac.gm,pc.gm)<=50000)
     + (SELECT count(*) FROM fac WHERE fac.tier='gravity_catchment' AND ST_Distance(fac.gm,pc.gm)<=50000) AS total_candidates,
   CASE WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM fac WHERE fac.tier=fr.rtier AND ST_Distance(fac.gm,pc.gm)<=50000)=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS widened,
   0 AS no_match,
   CASE WHEN (SELECT min(ST_Distance(fac.gm,pc.gm)) FROM fac WHERE fac.tier=fr.rtier)
             < 0.5*(SELECT min(d) FROM (SELECT ST_Distance(fac.gm,pc.gm) d FROM fac WHERE fac.tier=fr.rtier ORDER BY d LIMIT 2 OFFSET 1) x)
        THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS proximity_override
 FROM fr JOIN pc ON fr.cod_imovel=pc.cod_imovel ORDER BY fr.cod_imovel
) TO 'answers/q28.csv' (HEADER, DELIMITER ',');
"
echo "--- q28 ---"; cat answers/q28.csv
